title: obra/superpowers
lede: Superpowers is a set of auto-triggering skills that make a coding agent draw out a spec, write a plan, then build it with test-first subagents and a code review between tasks.

points: The workflow chains brainstorming, git worktrees, plan writing, subagent or inline execution, TDD, code review and branch finishing.
Plans are cut into tasks of two to five minutes, each with exact file paths, code and a verification step.
The TDD skill enforces red-green-refactor and deletes any code written before its failing test.
Installs as a plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Kimi Code, OpenCode and more, one install per harness.
A diagnosing-superpowers skill reads a session transcript to explain why a skill misfired or the agent strayed from its plan.

points.text: The most-discussed open issue: users say the v7 brainstorming questions get in the way.
Token cost, with one Codex user reporting that subagent-driven development used a full five-hour budget on a simple plan.
Requests to support Claude Code Agent Teams and its messaging and task-list tools.
Reports of slower responses after installing the skills, still waiting on a repro case.
